rows.abstract: Substantiates the policy of the State to encourage self-reliance among public educational institutions by allowing them greater flexibility in allocating and utilizing their incomes which are derived from their income-generati ng or entrepreneurship activities.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1995-10-02

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING LABOR-ONLY CONTRACTING , AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLE 106 OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 442, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES'
rows.abstract: Declares it UNLAWFUL for the employer and the contractor to enter into a LABOR-ONLY contract; prescribes penalties for the violation of the provisions of this Act.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05490

rows.author: A094
rows.title_full: AN ACT EXPANDING COUNTRYSIDE CREDIT THROUGH COOPERATIVE BANKS BY AMENDING SECTIONS 23 AND 83 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 337, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'GENERAL BANKING ACT'
rows.abstract: EXEMPTS the cooperative banks from the coverage of: 1) SBL(Single Borrower Limit) Rule - provides that the total liabilities of any person, company, corporation or firm to a commercial banking corporation for money borrowed, shall at no time exceed15% of the unimpaired capital and surplus of such bank. 2) DOSRT(Directors , Officers, Shareholders and Related Interests) Rule - provides that credit accommodations to directors, officers, shareholders and their related interests shall not exceed  an individual ceiling equivalent to the outstanding deposits plus the book value of his paid-in capital contribution in the bank.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 1995-10-02

rows.author: A012
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE EXECUTION OF SENTENCE FOR PERSONS CONVICTED OF BANK ROBBERY WITHIN NINETY (90) DAYS FROM THE FINALITY OF JUDGEMENT
rows.abstract: Provides for the immediate execution of sentence of convicted bank robbers to discourage bank robbery in the country.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1995-10-02

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE SHOWING OR EXHIBITION OF FILMS  OR BROADCAST OF PROGRAMS THAT FEATURES OR GLORIFIES THE LIFE OF ANY CANDIDATE DURING ELECTION PERIOD, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE 'OMNIBUS ELECTION CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES'
rows.abstract: Amends Section 85 of BP 881, otherwise known as the Omnibus Election Code of the Philippines by inserting a NEW paragraph after paragraph (c) to read as follows: "Sec. 85. Prohibited forms of election propaganda. - It shall be unlawful: xxx (C-A) TOPRODUCE, SHOW OR EXHIBIT FULL-LENGTH FILMS OR MOVIES OR BROADCAST OF RADIO PROGRAMS THAT FEATURES OR GLORIFIES THE LIFE OF A CANDIDATE."
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SUFFRAGE AND ELECTORAL REFORMS since 1995-10-02

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE UPGRADING OF THE MEDICAL FACILITIES OF ALL HEALTH CENTERS IN THE CITIES AND CAPITAL TOWNS OF PROVINCES, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Seeks to upgrade the medical facilities of health centers to enable them to provide basic medical services to the public and extend medical treatment to workers who suffer injuries or illness during their employment
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 1995-10-02

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING MULTIDISCIPLINA RY CANCER TREATMENT FACILITIES AND SPECIALIZED UNITS IN EVERY REGIONAL MEDICAL CENTERS IN THE COUNTRY, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Establishes a cancer center in ALL regional medical centers of the Philippines for the purpose of meeting the health care needs of the people of the entire country especially cancer victims.
